seo.title: Capri Palace Jumeirah: Anacapri Honeymoon Review (2026)
seo.description: Anacapri hilltop palace with 2-Michelin L’Olivo. Score 89/100, from $1,200/night. Verdict, suite pick, 7-night itinerary.

content.verdict: Capri Palace Jumeirah is the food-and-spa pinnacle on Capri — a 68-room cliff-edge property in the quieter, higher Anacapri half of the island, originally built by Italian hotelier Tonino Cacace in the 1960s, redesigned in the 1990s as a contemporary art-and-design hotel (the corridors and public rooms host a serious permanent collection — Cesare Tacchi, Vettor Pisani, Massimo Lippi), and acquired by Dubai’s Jumeirah Group in 2019 in a partnership that has elevated service to international five-star standard without losing the property’s distinct Italian artistic identity. The defining anchors are food and wellness. L’Olivo holds two Michelin stars under chef Andrea Migliaccio — the only two-star restaurant on the island and one of only a handful in Campania — serving Mediterranean creative tasting menus on the panoramic Anacapri terrace. The sister restaurant Il Riccio, on the cliff at the foot of the Anacapri road, holds one Michelin star and is the destination Capri seafood restaurant (book a year ahead in summer). The Capri Medical Spa, a 2,000 sqm wellness operation, is among the most credible medical spas in Italy — including the famous Leg School operated by Dr Francesco Canonaco specialising in leg-and-circulation programs that bring international celebrity clientele each summer. The infinity pool overlooks the Bay of Naples with the Punta Carena lighthouse in the distance. The Il Riccio Beach Club below the cliff is one of the great Capri swim platforms. The honeymoon move is the Megaron Suite — a 130 sqm rooftop suite with private hammam and pool. For the sweet spot, an Acanthus Suite with private terrace. The defining moment: dinner at L’Olivo on the candlelit terrace, two Michelin stars, the Capri lights below. Caveats: Anacapri is the quieter half — the Piazzetta scene in Capri Town is a 15-minute taxi ride away; at 68 rooms the property is larger than the J.K. Place’s 22; and the spa orientation can make the atmosphere feel more wellness-clinic than honeymoon-fizz. But for honeymooners who want the best food on the island, the most serious spa, and a quieter Anacapri base, Capri Palace Jumeirah is the obvious top choice.
content.best_room: A Megaron Suite — 130 sqm rooftop with private hammam and plunge pool. For the sweet spot, an Acanthus Suite with private terrace and sea view. Avoid the standard Mediterranean rooms without private outdoor space — lovely interiors but the terrace is the whole point.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Anacapri arrival
itinerary_7_nights.description: Sorrento hydrofoil to Marina Grande, then hotel taxi 15 min up to Anacapri. Welcome champagne in your Megaron Suite. Aperitivo at the pool. Dinner at L’Olivo (2 Michelin stars).

itinerary_7_nights.title: Around the island by boat
itinerary_7_nights.description: Private gozzo boat for the day — Faraglioni arch swim, Blue Grotto, lunch at Da Gelsomina or Lido del Faro. Return for the spa. Dinner at Il Riccio (1 Michelin star) at the beach club.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Da Paolino lunch
itinerary_7_nights.description: Taxi down to Da Paolino (10 min) for lemon-tree lunch. Up to the Piazzetta in Capri Town. Afternoon shopping via Camerelle. Funicular back. Dinner at Capri Palace.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Monte Solaro and Villa San Michele
itinerary_7_nights.description: Walk to the Anacapri chairlift (5 min from hotel). Up Monte Solaro for the summit view. Lunch at Da Gelsomina in Anacapri. Afternoon at Villa San Michele. Dinner at L’Olivo.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Spa day
itinerary_7_nights.description: Long morning at the Capri Medical Spa — couples treatment, hammam, indoor pool. Lunch at Il Riccio beach club. Afternoon swim and nap. Aperitivo at the pool. Dinner at Capri Palace.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Villa Jovis and Capri Town
itinerary_7_nights.description: Early taxi to Capri Town. Walk to Villa Jovis (45 min, 8am start). Lunch at La Capannina. Afternoon at the Gardens of Augustus and the Belvedere di Tragara. Final dinner at L’Olivo.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Slow departure
itinerary_7_nights.description: Final breakfast on your terrace. Hotel transfer down to Marina Grande for the hydrofoil back to Naples or Sorrento.

caveats: Anacapri base, not Capri Town. The Piazzetta scene is a 15-min taxi away.
68 rooms — larger and less intimate than J.K. Place or Punta Tragara.
Spa-clinic orientation can feel more wellness than honeymoon-fizz.

faqs.question: Good for honeymooners?
faqs.answer: Among the top Capri honeymoons — best food on the island (L’Olivo 2 stars, Il Riccio 1 star), best spa, panoramic pool. Less buzzy than the Quisisana.

faqs.question: Best time to visit?
faqs.answer: May, June, September, October. Closed November to mid-April.

faqs.question: Book in advance?
faqs.answer: Megaron Suite and Acanthus Suite 9–12 months for May–September. Standard rooms 6 months. L’Olivo dinner reservation built into room booking.

faqs.question: Adults-only?
faqs.answer: No, but the spa orientation and rate mean families are rare. Atmosphere is adult and quiet.

faqs.question: Best room type?
faqs.answer: Megaron Suite for the pinnacle. Acanthus Suite for the sweet spot. Avoid no-terrace standards.

faqs.question: How to get there?
faqs.answer: Naples (NAP). Sorrento hydrofoil to Marina Grande (25 min), then hotel taxi up to Anacapri (15 min). Or private speedboat from Naples direct to Marina Grande (70 min).
